original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳阿克拉北工业区火灾后，AMA拆除Kofikrom违建以开辟通道
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳阿克拉大都会议会（AMA）在加纳武装部队第48工程团的支援下，拆除了北工业区Kofikrom的未经授权建筑。此前占用者未遵守撤离指令。此举旨在为火灾后的救援开辟通道。

location.raw_text: Kofikrom in the North Industrial Area, Accra

key_facts.fact: 阿克拉大都会议会拆除北工业区Kofikrom的未经授权建筑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Accra Metropolitan Assembly (AMA), with support from the 48 Engineer Regiment of the Ghana Armed Forces, has removed unauthorised structures at Kofikrom in the North Industrial Area

key_facts.fact: 拆除原因是占用者未遵守撤离指令
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: after occupants failed to comply with a directive to vacate the area

key_facts.fact: 拆除行动旨在为火灾开辟通道
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: North Industrial Area fire: AMA demolishes Kofikrom structures to create access routes

uncertainties: 火灾的具体原因和损失情况尚未在文中说明
